contracts.README.md: Catalog(messages,fallback="en") reads a locale-to-key dictionary whose own entries are strings, including the empty string. get(locale,key) looks in the exact locale, then configured fallback, and returns key if absent. Lookup is case-sensitive. Locale and translation keys are arbitrary strings; inherited properties are not entries. translate(catalog,locale,key) is the public consumer. src/index.mjs exports Catalog and translate. Inputs are read-only to the library.
contracts.task:
try the requested locale, then repeatedly remove its final hyphen segment
then apply the same progressively shortened chain to the configured fallback locale
Empty-string translations stop lookup.
Ensure translate inherits the behavior without mutating messages or arguments.

baseline.test/public.test.mjs:
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {Catalog,translate} from '../src/index.mjs';
test('exact lookup and configured fallback',()=>{const c=new Catalog({en:{hello:'Hello',bye:'Bye'},fr:{hello:'Bonjour'}});assert.equal(translate(c,'fr','hello'),'Bonjour');assert.equal(c.get('fr','bye'),'Bye');assert.equal(c.get('fr','missing'),'missing');});
